verdict.rationale: Rootly's retrospectives feature explicitly auto-drafts postmortem sections (Summary, Impact, Root Cause, Mitigation, Resolution, Curated Timeline) from incident data, Slack, and call transcripts, and AI blocks draft sections like 'What Happened' or 'Contributing Factors' directly from incident context, with follow-ups tracked via action items and a real-time collaborative editor for human review. This covers timeline, contributing factors, and follow-ups generation with human-editable review workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of draft quality and no explicit community corroboration of the postmortem-drafting feature specifically.
